node.statement: Apply lem-stage1-polar-retraction using P,q and the first guard from 1.7.2. It says Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H is a C^1 diffeomorphism from calU x B_delta^{calH}(J) onto S_delta=Pi_delta(calU x B_delta^{calH}(J)); consequently it has the unique inverse denoted (u_delta,h_delta) in the root.
